shots.content: Inside a dining room, a rectangular table stands between a sideboard and patio doors, with a window along one side; a clear aisle runs opposite the window. There is one empty place. A woman in a green shirt sits in the sideboard-side window seat and proposes sharing breakfast with a neighbor, while a man in a white shirt sits in the sideboard-end seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from just beside the patio doors end, looking along the dining table toward the sideboard, with both window-side seats and the sideboard-end seat and the sideboard in frame.

shots.content: A man in an orange shirt enters and sits in the empty place. A woman in a green shirt explains the breakfast plan, and he agrees to share the food.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the aisle side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: A woman in a green shirt confirms the plan to help the neighbor.
shots.viewpoint: Top-down wide shot directly above the dining table.
